title: Module Status and Known Issues
introduction:
This document describes the current status of modules, known issues, and reasons for incomplete components.
*For general system-wide architectural limitations, see [General Issues](./general-issues.json).*

issues.title: Problems with `session` and `model!` Addressing
details: The main reason for the module's incompleteness.
The `authenticate.json` file contains references to the user model (`model!User`) that are unstable.
Saving the user session via `session!user` sometimes fails to maintain state between requests.

issues.title: Social Login
details: The module contains code for social network authentication, but it is not fully functional.
OAuth callbacks require refinement due to changes in social platform APIs.
`oauth-callback.json` and `process-social-login.json` files need updating.

issues.title: Validation
details: Form validation is partially implemented.
There are issues with displaying validation errors in the interface.
The input validation mechanism needs updating according to the new data structure.

refinements: Update the mechanism for working with `session` and resolve state persistence issues.
Rework validation for correct operation with the new data structure.
Update the authentication error handling mechanism.

issues.title: Actions Integration
details: The module is at the stage where actions and interactive logic need to be implemented.
The basic UI structure is created but not fully connected to the backend.
Additional handlers need to be created for all interactive elements.

issues.title: UI Popups and Dialogs
details: The module was intentionally left at a stage where modal windows and dialogs need implementation.
Components for displaying pop-up elements are missing.
Handlers for modal windows require refinement.

issues.title: Integration with Other Modules
details: Interaction with the Login Form module for authentication is partially implemented.
Insufficient integration with other system modules.
The navigation mechanism between sections needs improvement.

refinements: Create and implement all necessary actions to handle user interactions.
Develop UI components for modal windows and dialogs.
Improve interface responsiveness on various devices.

issues.title: Migration to New Data Structure
details: PrimeVue components are not fully adapted to the new data structure.
Part of the interface still works with outdated data exchange patterns.
Mechanisms for data transfer between components need updating.

issues.title: Action Refinement
details: Some actions use the legacy structure and need reworking.
Asynchronous operations sometimes cause state update issues.
The action rollback mechanism on errors needs improvement.

issues.title: Validation and Error Handling
details: The validation system requires reworking for the new data structure.
Improve UX for displaying errors to the user.
A more flexible system for configuring validation rules is needed.

refinements: Complete the migration of all components to the new data structure.
Update action handlers for more reliable operation.
Improve the validation system and error display.
Create more detailed documentation on using the module.

shortTerm: Fix critical issues with `session` and `model!` addressing in the Login Form module.
Complete basic actions integration in the Landing Page module.
Update critical PrimeVue components to work with the new data structure.
mediumTerm: Complete the migration of all modules to the new data structure.
Develop an improved form validation system.
Create a unified error handling mechanism for all modules.
Refine social login in the Login Form module.
longTerm: Fully update the UI of all modules for better responsiveness.
Develop comprehensive documentation for all modules.
Create an auto-testing system to verify functionality. # //TESTS LATER
Improve interaction between modules for a more integrated experience.

points: Use temporary workarounds for `session` issues (e.g., localStorage).
Verify authentication state persistence after each change.
Be cautious when integrating social login.
Focus on completing basic functionality before adding complex UI elements.
Test integration with other modules early. # //TESTS LATER
Follow a defined strategy when creating actions and popups.
Prioritize migrating components to the new data structure.
Carefully check validation after each change.
Test on various devices to ensure responsiveness. # //TESTS LATER
